prompt:
Hi, our FinTech startup FinPay is preparing for an enterprise client security and quality audit next week. We need a thorough code review of our backend and frontend source files located under the `finpay/` directory in the workspace.

Specifically, please review the files under `finpay/backend/api/`, `finpay/frontend/src/services/`, and `finpay/backend/tests/`. These files were written quickly under deadline pressure and we suspect there are serious security holes, performance problems, and style issues we've missed.

Please produce a formal written report saved as `code_review_report.md`. The report needs to be comprehensive — covering any security vulnerabilities you find, performance problems, code style issues specific to the languages used (Python and JavaScript), and your assessment of the test suite quality. We also want you to acknowledge anything that was done well.

This report will be presented directly to our enterprise client's security team, so it needs to be professional and well-structured.
